title: Warm Spicy Venezuelan Chicken Stew
description: A peppery and aerated weeknight Venezuelan dish featuring red pepper and render fat, cooked in a cataplana vessel. This stew is perfect for a quick and flavorful dinner.
instructions: Heat the rendered chicken fat in a cataplana vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chicken to the vessel and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper to the vessel and stir to combine.
Add the diced red bell pepper to the vessel and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and diced tomatoes to the vessel, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and serve hot.
Serve the stew in bowls, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
